summary: An omp seat is read as the account whose key file it reads, so two API-key accounts can have a login on one host

replay.detail: No claim kind or replay change.

schema.detail: No database schema change and no client contract change.

compatibility.detail: With one api-key account on a host nothing changes. With two, an unlabelled omp row is read as the one that declares the default key file, and a seat launched with ST_OMP_API_KEY_FILE records the account that declares that file.
